# Repository Instructions

This file is a repo-wide Copilot bridge, not the canonical workflow specification.

- Start from [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). It remains the primary workflow entrypoint.
- Treat repository documents as the source of truth rather than chat history alone.
- If an active execution plan exists, follow the update discipline in [docs/exec-plans/index.md](../docs/exec-plans/index.md) and do not rewrite the original implementation steps.
- Keep this file minimal. Workflow details live in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [docs/exec-plans/index.md](../docs/exec-plans/index.md).
